beforeRecord.title: Warden of the Quiet Mind
beforeRecord.lore: Beneath an oversized brown hood, Kobe carries the calm of a thousand silent vigils. His green energy blade moves only when words have failed. Stones lift around him as he turns an enemy’s momentum aside with a thought.

beforeRecord.name: Jace Hindu
beforeRecord.title: Keeper of the Sacred Vow
beforeRecord.lore: Jace places his faith in discipline, mercy and the sacred duty to protect life. Humble in speech and unwavering in judgment, he carries a purple energy sword as the final answer to cruelty. No borrowed enchantment can stand before his clear resolve.
beforeRecord.ability_desc: Deal 280% ATK damage to selected enemy.

beforeRecord.name: Ani Windwalker
beforeRecord.title: Bright Blade of the Rising Path

beforeRecord.name: Dark Lord
beforeRecord.title: Voice Behind the Black Mask

beforeRecord.name: Chewy
beforeRecord.title: The Roaring Bulwark
beforeRecord.lore: Chewy’s guttural roar can carry across a battlefield long after the guns fall silent. Beneath his long brown fur is a loyal heart and a strength few dare test. His crossbow and loaded utility bandolier stand between his companions and anyone foolish enough to pursue them.
